label: My return: updated return (ITR-U) - the rules

params.name: bars
params.label: s.139(8A) provisos - no updated return: a search (s.132) or requisition (s.132A) started, a survey (s.133A), an assessment / reassessment / revision pending or made for the year, prosecution started, information under another law (PMLA, Black Money, Benami, SAFEMA) held, already updated once for that year, a return of loss, or one that lowers the tax / raises the refund / raises a loss. (Finance Act 2025: after a s.148A notice only where the officer ordered it is not a fit case for reassessment.)

params.name: rate_pm
params.label: s.234A(1A) / s.234B(1A): 1% a month or part of a month on the further tax

params.name: floor_step
params.label: rule 119A: the tax interest is worked on is rounded down to a multiple of 100

params.name: b_min
params.label: s.208 / s.234B: advance tax due when the year's tax, less TDS, is 10,000 or more

params.name: b_pct
params.label: s.234B: interest when the advance tax paid is less than 90% of the assessed tax

params.name: reasons
params.label: ITR-U Part A: the reasons for updating the income (the department's codes)

params.name: schema_have
params.label: the department's ITR-U schema for an earlier AY is not in schemas/itr - the JSON is not made (the computation and the steps are given)

params.name: c_default
params.label: advance tax of that year with no instalment dates typed: taken as paid by 15 March (the last instalment)

description_nl: 2026-10-07: The updated return (s.139(8A), Finance Act 2022; 48 months from the end of the AY and 60% / 70% for the third / fourth year by the Finance Act 2025 - the additional tax is chip close.itr_u's): who may not file one, the interest, the reason codes. 2026-10-08: c_default - 234C of an updated return when the advance tax's instalments are not typed.
